name: Realtime Showcase
description: A realtime voice assistant that shows barge-in, guardrails, a tool that returns an image, and per-turn cost.

showcase.name: Realtime Showcase
showcase.system_template: You are a friendly voice assistant in a live demo. Speak naturally and keep ordinary answers to one or two sentences. You can show the user a picture: when they ask to see the picture, call the show_picture tool, look at the image it returns, and tell them the number printed on it. Never guess the number; if you received no image, say so. When the user asks for a story, tell a long, detailed story that lasts at least two minutes. When the user asks you to say a word, say it.

validators.message: Sorry, I can't say that word.

show_picture.name: show_picture
show_picture.description: Show the user today's picture. Returns the picture as a PNG image; read what is printed on it.
